maria-sec: Drafting a compact triage playbook + patch prioritization checklist. Need owners for KMS/RBAC/audit paths. @akshaya-sre @samir-ops

akshaya-sre: I can own infra-level vuln triage + patch windows. Quick question — do we want P1s auto-escalated to paging or just Slack @oncall?

samir-ops: P1s -> paging. P2s -> slack thread + 2h ack. P3 backlog. Also propose 72h for patch rollout for infra packages, 1 week for app-level deps.

jun-ml: For model infra, add evaluation gating: perf/regression test run before rollout. Fail -> rollback to canary.

maria-sec: Good. Draft checklist below — please comment.

maria-sec: ```triage_checklist
SEVERITY MAPPING:
  - P0: RCE or data-exfil, exploit in the wild
  - P1: Auth bypass, KMS key compromise possibility
  - P2: Privilege escalation on non-customer-facing infra
  - P3: Low-risk deps, fuzz/crash/no PoC
PRIORITIZATION RULES:
  1) Exploits in the wild -> immediate page + patch within 24h
  2) KMS/RBAC/Audit-impacting CVEs -> P1
  3) Transitive lib used by serving runtime -> bump priority
OWNER ASSIGNMENT:
  - infra kernel/gpu stack -> @akshaya-sre
  - runtime/model-serving -> @jun-ml
  - platform/api & RBAC -> @samir-ops
  - security triage lead -> @maria-sec
ROLLOUT POLICY:
  - Canary -> 5% for 2 hours
  - Monitor 30m for latency/error spikes
  - Full rollout in waves if no regression
AUDIT LOGS:
  - Enable high-fidelity logging for RBAC & KMS paths during rollout
  - Retain for 90 days for dev/test and 365 days for prod
```

akshaya-sre: Add step: pre-rollout smoke that hits /v1/health and token-auth flows.

samir-ops: Ops checklist: patch source, run `npm ci && npm audit --json > audit.json`, `cargo audit` (for infra services), run `gh api` to create PR and link CVE.

maria-sec: Also include escalation matrix snippet:

maria-sec: @oncall -> 1st contact (15m ack)
maria-sec: @eng-lead -> 2nd (30m)
maria-sec: Security exec -> only if P0/P1 or customer data impacted

deploy-bot: Scheduled patch window reminder: upcoming maintenance 2025-03-25 02:00 UTC :calendar: 

kevin-product: Heads-up: inform impacted customers if RBAC or audit log retention changes affect billing data access.

maria-sec: Okay assign owners in the repo and I'll spin up a short wiki page. Once owners are set, we'll automate triage labels via GH actions.

jun-ml: +1. I'll add model eval job to the CI that gates PRs touching serving runtime.

samir-ops: moving to infra board, creating cards for follow-up tasks.

maria-sec: Thanks team. Will post final playbook after edits. :thumbsup:
